gen-gf-oxanium-gf-epunda-slab: Big lowercase, clean monoline strokes, no fuss: Oxanium looks built rather than written. Epunda Slab, the classic serif of the two, has a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, bringing dignity against Oxanium's stress-free curves.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-piazzolla: Commanding from the first letter, Oxanium draws big lowercase in single-thickness strokes. Piazzolla, the classic serif underneath, has lowercase nearly matching its capitals and an e opened wide like a pried clasp.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, with a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and a generous e. Paprika, commanding and expressive, scatters capital-sized lowercase letters over the top.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-glegoo: Loud, widely scattered letters, with lowercase as big as capitals: that's Paprika. Glegoo, the refined classic serif, feels quieter and more editorial alongside, with big counters and unclosed curved mouths.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hanuman: Paprika scatters its capital-sized lowercase wide, commanding and expressive from the first line. Hanuman, the classic serif beneath, keeps a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, so extended reading feels traditional and refined.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noticia-text: Bold, widely spaced letters with a relaxed stride: that's Revalia. Noticia Text, the classic serif, lets long reading feel literary and dignified, with big entrances into curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the height.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla brings refined authority, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and its e opened like a pried clasp. Revalia, bold and expressive, spaces its letters widely above it, with a relaxed stride.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-pridi: Pridi reads classic and refined, its small letters standing proud. Revalia, bold and widely spaced, is the loud note here, its relaxed stride set against Pridi's generous gaps beside the stems.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-scope-one: Wide, relaxed, unmistakable: Revalia strides across the line with a tall band of letters. But Scope One, the text serif, does the steadier work: big x-height, stubby ascenders and descenders, counters spilling into space.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum is dignified and editorial, its c as open as a bent paperclip and its x-height reaching high. Revalia, meanwhile, takes the bold, expressive display work, with its letters spaced out in a relaxed stride.
